8111.title: Relative file routing requires a resolved workspace root
8111.rootCauseOneLine: Without a workspace root, core message routing omits relative-file context and permits default URL navigation; the reported browser-versus-desktop state difference remains unverified.
8111.proposedFix: Capture the failing client's environment query and root-path input first. If missing context is confirmed, defer file-link clicks until resolution without inventing a root or broadening path trust.
8111.caveats: Only the conditional DOM fallback was reproduced, twice. A known workspace root routes correctly. Chrome was unavailable, so no screenshot, real 404 navigation, Edge/macOS desktop comparison, or original user-state capture was obtained. No production fix or PR.
